meta.name: entra-agent-id
meta.description: Provision Microsoft Entra Agent Identity Blueprints, BlueprintPrincipals, and per-instance Agent Identities via Microsoft Graph, and configure OAuth 2.0 token exchange (fmi_path, OBO, cross-tenant) including the Microsoft Entra SDK for AgentID sidecar. USE FOR: Agent Identity Blueprint, BlueprintPrincipal, agent OAuth, fmi_path token exchange, agent OBO, Workload Identity Federation for agents, polyglot agent auth, Microsoft.Identity.Web.AgentIdentities. DO NOT USE FOR: standard Entra app registration (use entra-app-registration), Microsoft Foundry agent authoring (use microsoft-foundry).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为AI代理配置Microsoft Entra身份蓝图与OAuth令牌交换
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在Microsoft Entra中为AI代理管理身份和OAuth流程
copy.tagline_en: Provision Microsoft Entra agent identity blueprints and configure OAuth token exchange
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage agent identities and OAuth flows in Microsoft Entra

howto.what: 这个技能让 Claude 能通过 Microsoft Graph 为 AI 代理创建和管理独立的身份（Agent Identity），包括创建蓝图、服务主体和代理身份，并配置 OAuth 2.0 令牌交换。
howto.when: 当你需要为 AI 代理设置独立的 Microsoft Entra 身份，或配置代理的 OAuth 2.0 令牌交换（如 fmi_path、OBO、跨租户）时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个新的 Agent Identity Blueprint。
say.note: Claude 会调用 Graph API 创建蓝图对象。

say.text: 为我的代理实例创建一个 Agent Identity。
say.note: Claude 会在蓝图下创建代理身份服务主体。

say.text: 配置代理的 OAuth 2.0 令牌交换（fmi_path）。
say.note: Claude 会指导你完成两步令牌交换设置。

howto.what_en: This skill enables Claude to create and manage distinct identities for AI agents via Microsoft Graph, including Blueprints, BlueprintPrincipals, and per-instance Agent Identities, and configure OAuth 2.0 token exchange.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to provision Microsoft Entra identities for AI agents or configure OAuth 2.0 token exchange (e.g., fmi_path, OBO, cross-tenant).

say_en.text: Create a new Agent Identity Blueprint for me.
say_en.note: Claude will call Graph API to create the blueprint object.

say_en.text: Create an Agent Identity for my agent instance.
say_en.note: Claude will create an agent identity service principal under the blueprint.

say_en.text: Configure OAuth 2.0 token exchange (fmi_path) for the agent.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through the two-step token exchange setup.
